_help: Lines Yellowmetal lists that the Buildocrat Rate Book does not price yet. Same field names as rate-data.json. 'base' + 'f' derives a rate from a rate-book line (so it moves when the rate book moves); 'usd' prices an import at USD x landed factor x the rate book's exchange rate; 'sum' adds rate-book lines together (tractor + trailer). Confidence stays LOW until replaced by a quote.
